newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade at $62, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade at $62, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 10 (Reuder) - Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Inquiry and demand was good. Cattle were in strong hands. Confirmed - 6,100 Last week- 300 Last year- 44,500
Week to date - 87,800 Last week - 76,600 Last year- 63,800
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1275 lbs 61.50-62.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 61.50-62.00.

Sales confirmed on 2,000 slaughter steers and 4,100 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 87,800 head confirmed including 21,600 head or about 25 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
